scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply vev --local && wrangler dev --env local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787 --assets ./dev-assets
scripts.live: wrangler d1 migrations apply vev --local && wrangler dev --env local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.deploy:preview: wrangler versions upload --env preview --var GIT_COMMIT:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
scripts.migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply vev-preview --env preview --remote
